<subject>Re: moving on</subject>
<body>
Congratulations, I thought you were going to join Médecins Sans Frontières. How long until you can work on a new medical research project again? I'm sure your experience in clinical operations will be valuable. 
I'm looking forward to hearing about your new role and how it will impact the healthcare services industry. Will you still be based in Lyon or will you be relocating? 
Please keep me updated on your new contact information, I'd like to stay in touch. 

Best regards,
Jacques Huet, Coordinator
Lumière Santé SAS
+33 4 72 34 56 78
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: marine.dossantos@lumieresante.fr
Sent: mercredi 2 avril 2025 14:05:52
To: marine.dossantos@lumieresante.fr
Subject: moving on



i've resigned from Hôpital Privé de Lyon today. it is a difficult decision from the stand point that I have been very happy in the short time I've been here. I will still be in the healthcare business doing very much the same as I am doing now. I felt that the opportunity which came up was the best thing for my career and family in the long term. I look forward to speaking to all of you in the future and I'll contact you as soon as I get set up in the next couple of weeks. home phone +33 4 55 56 95 35 home email o3507@aol.com regards,steve
